architecture.mechanism: Dual-estimator structure combining Coulomb counting, OCV correction, and extended Kalman filter
architecture.intervention: Implement a battery management algorithm using Coulomb counting for immediate discharge tracking, corrected by low-current open-circuit voltage measurements and an extended Kalman filter to estimate true state-of-charge without disconnecting the battery or resetting control modules.
architecture.expected_effect: Accurate restoration of 12V system voltage through targeted charging based on precise state-of-charge estimation, preventing overcharging or undercharging while maintaining continuous power to preserve stored control module codes.
architecture.falsification_test: Connect the battery to a programmable load simulating parasitic drain, apply the proposed estimation algorithm, and verify if the calculated state-of-charge matches the actual capacity measured by a full discharge test within a 5% error margin.
